expected_response.note: No registered bounded edit has a defensible expected advantage; incumbent retained.

failure_modes: No registered bounded edit expresses the pair-kernel contrast because the executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel term.
Landmark occupancy/softmin contrasts are sign-inconsistent across landmarks and mostly fail BH adjustment, so a region_index edit is not defensibly favored.
Regional moment (local_cyy) and joint-motion terms are diagnostic only and are not in the executing pointcloud scalar.
Descendant survival credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity, and disagrees in sign with immediate selection contrasts.
Increasing displacement risks raising joint_internal_RMS_A and joint_innovation_RMS_A, which are reproducible negative contrasts.
Time-conditioned alternatives are unsupported because first/last rates have opposite signs with many sign conflicts and legendre_runtime_allowed is false.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest and most reproducible signed contrasts are the short-range pair-distance shells pair_kernel_1.5-5.0 (endpoint_effects:9-12, positive batch fraction 1.0 for 1.5/2.5/3.5) reversing at pair_kernel_7.0 (endpoint_effects:13, positive batch fraction 0.0), surviving branch adjustment (branch_adjusted:86,87,240,241; reversal at :244). However, the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; observable_definitions pair_kernel meaning: radial pair-distance shell density, not a bond label or interaction energy), so no registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) can express that contrast. The landmark occupancy/softmin contrasts are sign-inconsistent across landmarks (endpoint_effects:14-16,20-25,29-34,59-61,68-70) and mostly fail multiplicity adjustment (branch_adjusted:0-73), so no single region_index is defensibly favored. The global shape_yy negative contrast (endpoint_effects:4, q 1.5e-5, positive batch fraction 0.0; branch_adjusted:158,235) and the per-landmark local_cyy negative enrichment (regional_effects:5,15,...,195) are coherent, but the regional moment term is diagnostic only and is not in the executing pointcloud scalar; a region_index edit would change landmark attention, not the moment observable, and the evidence does not establish which landmark's attention change would raise final predicted affinity. Centroid contrasts are weak and null after adjustment (endpoint_effects:0-2; branch_adjusted:77-79,231-233). Descendant survival credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available false; lineage_support multiple-testing scope), and it disagrees in sign with immediate selection contrasts for several local_cyy/czz features (survival_effects:23,46,56,75,96,146,156,165,195), so it cannot justify an edit. Increment and turnover diagnostics disagree with population contrasts (increment_effects:3,4,7,10,13,14,15,25,34,63; turnover:14,17,47,134,224,227,254,257,497,524,527,584,587) and are accounting diagnostics, not causal selection effects. Joint diagnostics show selection innovation positively associated with native alignment and teacher innovation-contrast alignment but negatively with observed child score gain (joint_diagnostics:1,2,11,14,15; information_audit), and joint-motion contrasts are reproducible negatives (branch_adjusted:74-76,151-153,228-230,305-307), which argues against increasing displacement. Time variation is large with opposite-sign first/last rates and many sign conflicts (continuous:0-19; curve_support legendre_runtime_allowed false), so no time-conditioned alternative is supported. Temperatures are immutable and no temperature edit is proposed. Because no registered bounded edit has a defensible expected advantage for the primary objective, retaining the incumbent is the correct choice; the evidence that would change this decision is a reproducible, multiplicity-surviving signed contrast on an observable that the executing pointcloud scalar actually contains, or a region_index whose attention change is shown to raise final predicted affinity without increasing joint internal/innovation RMS.
